name: Stellula Eques ~Shokuzai no Himekishi~
original_name: ステルラエクエス～贖罪の姫騎士～
source:
One day protagonist sees a beautiful girl being attacked by monsters. When he saves her, he realizes that she is an old childhood friend. She tells him that she is actually a magical knight fighting to save the earth. They can't help but fall in love with each other. Now she must keep her sense of duty and not lose herself in his love giving up the fight. Is it still possible to save the earth ?

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=520845]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
一天，主人公看见一名美丽少女遭到怪物袭击。救下她后，他才发现对方原来是儿时旧识。少女告诉他，自己其实是一名为拯救地球而战的魔法骑士。两人情不自禁地相爱了。如今，她必须坚守使命，不能沉溺于这份爱情而放弃战斗。地球还有可能得救吗？

[翻译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=520845]Getchu[/url]]
